title: Eggchantments
description: Eggchantments lets you enchant eggs with powerful abilities, turning them into deadly projectiles! From explosive impacts to lightning strikes, these enchanted eggs bring a whole new way to battle in Minecraft.
body:
# Eggchantments – Enchanted Eggs with Powerful Abilities!
(You are allowed to use this mod in your modpack)

Ever wished eggs were more than just a food item? With Eggchantments, you can enchant eggs with powerful abilities, turning them into deadly projectiles!

## 
## New Egg Enchantments: 

-     Return – Your egg returns to you after being thrown, like a boomerang!
-     Damage – Increases the damage dealt by your thrown eggs.
-     Eggsplosive – Causes a powerful explosion upon impact!
-     Lightning – Summons a lightning bolt where the egg lands.
-     Unbreggable – The egg doesn’t break! Instead, it drops as an item when thrown.

# How to Obtain Egg Enchantments

You can't enchant eggs directly in an enchanting table! Instead, you must first enchant a book with your desired Eggchantment, then apply it to an egg using an anvil.
